basis: Mitochondrial metabolic disease defined by progressive white-matter, brainstem and spinal cord dysfunction; weakness is neurologic, not evidence of primary muscle damage.
Neuroendocrine tumor arising in gastrointestinal epithelium; peptide production alone does not establish an additional endocrine gland disorder.
Inherited cardiac electrical disorder causing ventricular arrhythmias and characteristic conduction abnormalities.
Localized loss of visual field defines an ocular functional disorder; no specific neurologic cause is inherent to this concept.
Malignant germ cell tumor originating in the testis, a reproductive site outside the axes; endocrine dysfunction is not intrinsic.
Triglyceride storage damages myocardium and coronary arteries; skeletal myopathy occurs in 80-99%. Leukocyte vacuoles and hepatomegaly alone do not establish functional damage.
Growth and skeletal abnormalities define the syndrome; developmental delay occurs in 3/5. Blue sclerae do not establish eye damage; thin skin alone does not establish injury.
Congenital cardiac positional malformation with the heart located in the midline.
Necrotizing inflammatory hypophysitis destroys pituitary tissue; generally considered immune-mediated. Pituitary involvement belongs to the endocrine axis.
Myofibrillar muscle degeneration and axonal motor neuropathy define the syndrome; isolated 1/1 extraorgan reports do not establish involvement in >=30% across reported patients.
Dysplastic tubular epithelial neoplasm arising in the small intestine.
Precursor B-cell leukemia/lymphoma is a blood and marrow malignancy; the lymphoma component also warrants the immune mechanism axis.
Ovarian failure and skeletal growth defects define Turner syndrome; cardiac malformations occur in ~30-50%, hearing loss in >50%. Renal anomalies (~30-40%) omitted under cap.
Alpha-sarcoglycan deficiency causes skeletal muscle dystrophy; a historical neurologic parent does not establish nerve damage.
Syndrome defined by multiple cutaneous nodules and urinary tract abnormalities, supported by duplicated collecting systems and hydronephrosis.
GJA3-related nonsyndromic cataract directly affects the lens; no extraocular disease is intrinsic.
Localized dermal elastic tissue disorder producing persistent fibrous papules.
Defined by chronic widespread muscular pain, tenderness and stiffness; headache, fatigue and sleep disturbance do not establish additional organ damage.
Umbrella for inherited branched-chain amino acid metabolic defects; neurologic injury varies by subtype and its frequency across the group is not established.
Familial hepatocellular adenomas arise in liver; associated HNF1A-related diabetes is a separately diagnosed disease.
Occlusion of the central retinal artery is a vascular disorder directly affecting retinal perfusion and vision.
Distal skeletal muscle disease defined by calf weakness and gastrocnemius medialis atrophy; no extraorgan involvement is supplied.
Iron-deficiency anemia and esophageal webs with dysphagia form the defining triad; glossitis is also gastrointestinal. Nail abnormalities occur in only 5-29%.
Complex I metabolic defect; developmental dysfunction and hypertrophic cardiomyopathy each reported in 1/1. Respiratory insufficiency alone does not establish lung damage.
HTLV-1-associated chronic infected eczema; later leukemia and myelopathy are separate diseases. Nasal discharge and crusting alone do not establish airway damage.
